tasks.prTitle: docs(eng-harness): read-back rule R3 and the projection of combination edits agree on the effect key (B-498)
tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; a chat line of the owner is not your task; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. Documents-only amendment on the first-live-run path (lead decision D-28: the smallest text that does each item); it must merge before the edit-cycle plan task T3 (calc harness.expected_effects, not yet written) starts. PART 1, a DEFECT found and reproduced by the reviewer and the verifiers of calcs T9 (pull request 338, merged: read its Review section and the merged calc packages/eng-harness/src/eng_harness/calcs/ read-back module and its tests): calcs spec 0003 section 4.8 rule R3 requires an expected effect to have the same section and key as the reported change, and section 4.7 D2 (as amended by B-469 and B-483) reports a change of one combination item under the nested key [combinations, C, items, case, case_type]; edit-cycle spec 0007 section 4.4.2 projects a load_combination_set (or add) as one `set`/`add` effect on the whole combination, key [combinations, C]. So a correctly written combination scale change gives an `unexpected` row and FAIL: the edit cycle's combination edits cannot pass. Decide it from the documents with the smallest rule consistent with sections 4.7 and 4.8 of spec 0003, section 4.4.2 and rule K6 of spec 0007, and the merged code. Two candidate repairs: (a) spec 0007 section 4.4.2 projects combination edits per item, with the keys D2 reports (check that a resolved change set holds what the projection then needs: items added, changed and removed against the before state; the projection is a calc and may only use its inputs); (b) R3 lets an effect on a parent key explain the changes reported under its nested keys (state exactly how values are then compared). PREFER the repair that leaves merged code unchanged (a), if and only if the documents support it fully; if (b) or a mix is needed, merged calc 3 must change: then add one small plan task to plan 0003 after T9 (id T9b, own files, tests_first inside the task, covers a new acceptance criterion with its test name, depends_on T9, realistic budget; it will get a work item from the lead) exactly as amendment B-469 added T8c, and make the edit-cycle plan task T3 (and whatever else needs it) depend on it in the cross-plan prose. Check the same question for every other edit kind of spec 0007 section 4.4.2 whose object has nested keyed lists in D2 (for example load patterns with loads, sections with members): state for each that the projected key equals the reported key, or repair it the same way. Add or adjust the acceptance criterion and named test of spec 0007 that pins a combination edit passing read-back. PART 2, record in spec 0003 as plain sentences, without new behaviour, four readings that merged code made and reviewers accepted: (1) AC38 asks for status NEEDS_ENGINEER with the message "no design results" but the kind harness.design_summary/1 has no message field: say where the reasons live (read the calc of pull request 343 / branch feat/b149-harness-ct10-calc-4-design-results in the worktree <worktrees>/b149, read-only: trace step `status_reasons`); (2) section 4.9 S5: `changes` when `previous` is absent is all lists empty; (3) section 4.8: a `remove` effect whose object is still present gives mismatch; an effect under a key that occurs more than once is compared with every object and matches only when all match; the trace outputs are [identical, status]; (4) section 4.12: the HarnessCalcPort signature carries `basis_fields`, supplied when the port is constructed (assembly), and one sentence in spec 0007 section 4.5 that agrees with it (who wires the workflow's BASIS_FIELDS). PART 3, do NOT decide these; write each as a numbered open question in the spec's open-questions section with a recommendation marked as the writer's: whether an effect whose unit differs from the field's canonical unit is refused (nothing reads Effect.unit today); whether calc 4 refuses verdicts whose source is not `host` (Q7) or verdicts and frames of different models; how R0's '(or its working copy)' can be recognised when RefMeta has no derived_from. Rules: every changed plan still covers every acceptance criterion of its spec (GC016), tasks stay within 400 lines, tests_first files belong to their own task (TF008), depends_on ids exist. Do not edit code or lead state files. Invent no tolerance or engineering value. Run `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation`. In your summary give the lead: which repair you chose and why, any new plan task with files and budget, and the open-question ids. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.
